tess: quick heads-up 44 onboarding run for `zephyr-30b-int4b` on staging (48k ctx) produced a reproducible mismatch centered on a kvcache sequence boundary at ~16384 tokens. filing here before opening an MR.

omar: can you paste the smallest repro and a log excerpt? :mag_right:

tess: repro: `python tests/long_prefill.py --model zephyr-30b-int4b --prefill 17000 --ctx 49152 --seed 202`

log snippet: 
```
[2026-11-02T07:20:34Z] prefill.start id=pf-c73a tokens=17000 model=zephyr-30b-int4b
[2026-11-02T07:20:42Z] kvcache.alloc shard=0 window=12288->16384 page_size=4096 page_seq=45 page_hash=3b9f1c
[2026-11-02T07:20:42Z] rope.rescale_probe window=16384 delta=0.00095 kernel=int4b
[2026-11-02T07:20:42Z] kvcache.commit shard=0 page_seq=46 page_hash=3b9f1c
[2026-11-02T07:20:43Z] decode.token 16380 tok=but prob=0.037
[2026-11-02T07:20:44Z] decode.token 16395 tok=but prob=0.0008  <-- abrupt prob collapse
[2026-11-02T07:20:44Z] warning: kvcache.seq_mismatch expected=46 observed=45 (prefill_id=pf-c73a)
```

nav: interesting: seq_mismatch logged after commit. does the decoder read old seq while rescale in-flight?

quant-lab-bot: quick fingerprint: int4b kernel uses 8-element pack stride and a new memcpy path. QLAB-672 notes that when page_seq updates and rescale applies concurrently, small rounding in dequant can flip high-prob candidates near separators.

omar: did you try toggling `--kvcache-seqnum` telemetry or setting `KVCACHE_SEQNUM_VERBOSE=1`? we need ordered write traces.

tess: yes, i re-ran with `KVCACHE_SEQNUM_VERBOSE=1` and attached minimal logs to CI. pattern: when rescale triggers within ~20ms of page commit, seqnum read races and decoder sometimes samples a low-prob token.

ci-bot: artifacts uploaded: https://ci.internal/reports/4783/zephyr-longprefill.log

ops-bot: i've queued a controlled sweep: job=staging-longprefill-4783 matrix=[fp16,int8,int4b] runs=8 flags=[KVCACHE_SEQNUM_VERBOSE=1,ROPE_RESCALE_DEBUG=1,KV_LOG_EXTRA=1] ETA ~12m.

nav: do we see this across quant variants? tess, what did you see fn-local?

tess: local quick matrix: fp16/rescale=true -> clean 10/10; int8/rescale=true -> rare jitter 1/10; int4b/rescale=true -> 7/10 failures at that boundary. rescale=false -> int4b clean 10/10.

omar: strong sign rescale + seqnum race. two immediate hypotheses: (1) rescale mutates rotary offsets and writes a transient page marker before seqnum increment, consumer sees old seq but new offsets (or vice versa); (2) int4b pack/unpack memcpy ordering plus dequant rounding amplifies tiny index changes into different top-k tokens.

quant-lab-bot: additional note: QLAB-672 recommends adding a monotonic commit barrier (atomic seqnum bump after fully flushing page writes) and a cheap pack-order assert in the unpack path to detect reversed memcpy.

nav: actionable next steps:
- omar to add a tiny guard in runtime: defer applying rescale until after page_seq is confirmed committed (flag `--rescale-wait-for-seq=true`) and run the sweep.
- tess to add token-diff CSV (16280-16410) and attach to MR.
- ops to run the sweep (already queued) and share per-run seqnum timelines.

omar: implemented local quick guard `--rescale-wait-for-seq=true` and ran 20 local runs: int4b failures dropped from 7/10 to 0/20 (rescale still applied but deferred until seq confirmed). small perf overhead (~1.4%).

ci-bot: job 4783 scheduled with extra flags. logs will be at https://ci.internal/reports/4783/

ops-bot: reminder: we should also test `--kvcache-sync-commit=true` to force synchronous commits and compare frequency; scheduling small follow-up when sweep finishes.

tess: i've uploaded diffs and the minimal reproduce script in MR draft: https://git.internal/r/zephyr-prefill-issue/diffs. MR includes token diffs, logs, and the reproduce command.

omar: long-term fixes we discussed: (A) make kvcache page commit atomic with seqnum bump only after full page flushed; (B) add consumer-side check to ignore reads with seqnum < committed_seq; (C) audit int4b memcpy pack/unpack paths to ensure ordering; (D) add longprefill gating in quant model onboarding at multiple boundaries (8k,16k,32k) with rescale on/off.

nav: i'm going to propose a short addition to the onboarding checklist: "Run longprefill smoke with rescale toggled and KVCACHE_SEQNUM_VERBOSE enabled; fail if seq_mismatch or token-divergence at 8k/16k/32k."

quant-lab-bot: suggested mitigation PR refs/heads/qlab/atomic-seq-commit includes unit tests simulating concurrent rescale+commit and reduces failure rate in synthetic bench.

omar: i'll open a small hotfix PR to gate `--rescale-wait-for-seq=true` by default for quant onboards and include a perf table. please review early.

tess: thanks all 4 will update thread when CI sweep completes and when MR opens. ping me for access to the staging logs. :thumbsup:
